# Cloud Social Work

> Cloud Social Work provides Therapeutic Supports for NDIS participants (NDIA Managed, Plan Managed and Self Managed) and Social Work services in the Illawarra (including Wollongong), Nowra and Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

Cloud Social Work is a person-centred social work practice led by Michael McGowan. The practice does not provide Assist Travel Transport, Household Tasks, or Innovative Community Participation.

## Contact

- Website: https://www.cloudsocialwork.com.au/
- Email: michael.mcgowan8@hotmail.com
- Phone: 0451 011 473
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9am–5pm, Saturday 9am–noon, Sunday closed
- Areas served: Illawarra (including Wollongong), Nowra, and Sydney
